description: Essex Property Trust, Inc., a Maryland corporation and an S&P 500 company, operates as a self-administered and self-managed real estate investment trust, owning all of its interest in its real estate and other investments directly or indirectly through Essex Portfolio, L.P., of which it is the sole general partner with an approximately 96.6 percent general partner interest as of December 31, 2025. It has elected to be treated as a REIT for federal income tax purposes commencing with the year ended December 31, 1994 and completed its initial public offering on June 13, 1994, and to maintain compliance with REIT tax rules it utilizes taxable REIT subsidiaries for various revenue generating or investment activities. The company focuses on acquiring and developing apartment communities in supply constrained markets, and redeveloping its existing communities to improve the financial and physical aspects of its communities.
